sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2026/01/PXD063326/ (LCMS_rawfile.zip, LCMS_rawfile_2.7z, LCMS_rawfile_3.zip, LCMS_rawfile_4.zip; central directories read)

claims.evidence: Run folder names read from zip/7z directories; archives are the deposited files.
PRIDE organism NEWT:10090, organism part blood serum, description 'immunoprecipitated IgG isolated from mouse serum'.
Description: serum from 10 month old Vlambda2 315m+/- TCR TG+/- mice. Applied to all non-rIG runs by inference; C_Rama genotype not available.
Paper states lymphomas had BALB/c background; cohort strain inferred.
Description: recombinant human IgG3 processed in parallel as positive control; run name rIG.
Sample processing protocol and PRIDE instrument MS:1003124.
Protocol: AspN 1 h then trypsin overnight; MaxQuant Trypsin/P. Asp-N not representable in single column.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl protein N-term variable

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance]; comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: mainSearchTol 10 ppm; TOF MatchTolerance 40 ppm (MaxQuant default).
Protocol: DDA with PASEF; lcmsRunType TIMS-DDA.

limitations: No run-to-sample map is deposited; sample identity of non-rIG runs inferred from project description.
Raw files are only inside archives; mqpar lists additional runs not deposited.
Asp-N co-digestion not representable in single-valued cleavage column.
Dissociation method, sex, disease, alkylation reagent not stated.
